title: Zero to RAG (SQLite as Vector Store)

cues.en: Hi, in my previous video about zero-to-rag, I went through the entire steps of doing everything
cues.zh: 大家好，前一支 Zero to RAG 影片，示範了完整的操作流程，

cues.en: from absolutely zero to being able to build an agent that could search that rag tool.
cues.zh: 從零開始，一直到建立能使用 RAG 工具搜尋的代理程式。

cues.en: This is a follow-up companion video where we actually switch out some of the vector store providers and embedding providers.
cues.zh: 這是一支補充影片，會替換部分向量儲存區與嵌入模型供應商。

cues.en: We're going to stay with Azure OpenAI, but we're going to switch to SQLite instead of the in-memory database.
cues.zh: 這次仍然使用 Azure OpenAI，但把記憶體資料庫改成 SQLite。

cues.en: So in order to do that, we have a new project here, and the only thing we really need is
cues.zh: 為此，我在這裡建立了一個新專案。唯一真正需要新增的是，

cues.en: since it's SQLite, we need a SQLite connection string and a new NuGet image.
cues.zh: 因為改用 SQLite，所以需要 SQLite 連線字串，以及新的 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: So in order to do this, we are going to go up to connectionstrings.com, which is where
cues.zh: 先前往 connectionstrings.com，我通常會從這裡，

cues.en: I use it, and I tend to take my systems from here.
cues.zh: 查找需要使用的連線字串格式。

cues.en: So we're going to put in a connection string, and just so it's a little easier for me and
cues.zh: 接著填入連線字串。為了讓你我在各自電腦上都容易操作，

cues.en: you that we all have, I'm going to say path.temp.
cues.zh: 我會使用暫存路徑。

cues.en: Go into my temp folder, but we still need a name for the database.
cues.zh: 也就是放進我的 temp 資料夾，但仍然要指定資料庫檔名。

cues.en: So we put in a connection string, and that connection string needs to be in a new NuGet package.
cues.zh: 填好連線字串後，還需要安裝新的 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: So if we go to NuGet, we have our in-memory installed.
cues.zh: 到 NuGet 看看，目前已經安裝了 InMemory。

cues.en: We could technically take that away now, but I'm just going to leave it so it's easier for you to see the difference.
cues.zh: 技術上可以移除，但我會先留著，讓你比較容易看出差異。

cues.en: But we're going to go in here and say CommunityToolkit.vectorData, and the SQLite is in preview still.
cues.zh: 這裡搜尋 CommunityToolkit.VectorData，而 SQLite 套件目前仍在預覽階段。

cues.en: The others have released, but this one is in preview.
cues.zh: 其他套件已經正式發布，但這個還是預覽版。

cues.en: So remember to put in include pre-releases, and we're going to install that one.
cues.zh: 記得勾選 Include prerelease，再安裝這個套件。

cues.en: So now you might think we need to do a lot of tweaking, but actually the only thing place we need to go is where we define our vector store.
cues.zh: 你可能以為需要修改很多地方，但其實只需要到定義向量儲存區的位置，

cues.en: Instead of an in-memory vector store, we're simply going to say a new SQL vector store.
cues.zh: 把 InMemoryVectorStore 換成 SQLite 的向量儲存區。

cues.en: And the other one didn't really take any parameters because it was just in-memory.
cues.zh: 原本的版本不需要傳入什麼參數，因為資料只存在記憶體裡。

cues.en: Now we need a connection string, which is why I put in the SQLite connection string.
cues.zh: 現在需要連線字串，這就是剛才準備 SQLite 連線字串的原因。

cues.en: And it still needs some options, but those options will be 100% the same.
cues.zh: 還需要一些選項，但那些選項與之前完全相同。

cues.en: That is actually it.
cues.zh: 實際上就只有這樣。

cues.en: Put in the connection string and switch to a different store, and everything else works exactly the same.
cues.zh: 加入連線字串，再換成不同的儲存區，其他內容就能照原樣運作。

cues.en: We run it, it will actually fail.
cues.zh: 不過，現在直接執行，其實會失敗。

cues.en: And let me show it.
cues.zh: 我示範給你看。

cues.en: And it's fairly simple.
cues.zh: 原因也很簡單，

cues.en: It says just that the connection string with version is not supported, so we just need
cues.zh: 它指出連線字串不支援 Version 這個設定，所以只需要，

cues.en: to go up and take that away because it will put it in by itself.
cues.zh: 回到上面將它移除，因為系統會自行處理。

cues.en: Once we do that, our embedding begins like before, and we end up with our answer.
cues.zh: 完成後，就會和之前一樣開始產生嵌入向量，最後得到答案。

cues.en: If we look into the SQLite, I have a small thing called SQLite browser here, and we can
cues.zh: 要查看 SQLite 資料，我這裡有個 SQLite Browser 工具，可以，

cues.en: go to our gem folder and find it. MyDB here.
cues.zh: 到 temp 資料夾，找到這裡的 MyDB。

cues.en: You will see that SQLite is a bit strange in that it doesn't make just one table.
cues.zh: 可以看到 SQLite 有點特別，不是只建立一張資料表，

cues.en: It creates a bunch of extra tables in order to do vectorization.
cues.zh: 而是為了向量化，建立了一些額外的資料表。

cues.en: This is just limitation of SQL.
cues.zh: 這與 SQL 本身的限制有關。

cues.en: Every single one of the vector stores have different ways of doing things.
cues.zh: 每一種向量儲存區，都有各自不同的實作方式。

cues.en: But beyond that, there's nothing more to it than a different NuGet package down here with a connection string.
cues.zh: 除此之外，差別就只有這裡換了 NuGet 套件，並加入連線字串。

cues.en: So that covers SQLite.
cues.zh: 以上就是 SQLite 的部分。
